::This petite, middle-aged woman you see before you seems to be studying some medical charts. Since your eyes were immediately drawn to the charts she was holding, you are quick to notice that one of her hands is badly scarred. The horribly warped skin of her left hand, diffusing from a few spots and contrasting her otherwise clear skin, seems to have been caused by the healing of a deep burn.

However, her voice offers yet another surprise: It is a product of two clearly separate, violently dissonant voices clashing against each other before merging into one jarring sound.::<end>
